newsitem.title: USA: Enron Oil says q2 through q4 revenue cost.
newsitem.headline: Enron Oil says q2 through q4 revenue cost.

text.p: Enron Oil and Gas Corp directors will discuss a stock buyback in the next few days, said Chairman Forest Hogland on Wednesday.
"We have been buying stock of late and the board meeting will discuss the matter. I consider this stock to be very low," he told the PaineWebber annual energy conference.
Hogland also said Enron Oil is reviewing its hedging policy. "We will not hedge at the levels we have been doing, 50 percent of (natural) gas. We'll change it or may go completely unhedged."

In the first quarter of 1997, he said, revenue reductions from closing most natural gas hedges will total $39 million before tax. In the second through fourth quarters reductions will close 20 million for closing all natural gas hedges.
In 1996, revenue reductions from hedging amounted to 47 percent of wellhead price increases, Hogland said.
He said this was equal to another $0.25 per share of earnings.
